title: Skill SKILL.md frontmatter (schema_version 1)
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter block of every SKILL.md / mode-pack / standard file authored under the studio.

name.description: Identifier. Skill / mode-pack / agent-router types must additionally match kebab-case (^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]*$); the linter enforces that. Title Case allowed for primitive / reference / standard.

description.description: One sentence; surfaces in routing manifests and CLAUDE.md generation.

schema_version.description: Authoring Standard version this file conforms to.

version.description: Optional skill-level semver, independent of schema_version.

budget_tokens.description: Advisory model budget for sessions invoking this skill.

authoring_standard.description: Vendored verbatim only; bypasses body grammar lints.

transition_notes.description: Path to a migration / transition document referenced by the linter as informational.

snapshots.description: Mode-pack-only: declared snapshot files this pack consumes; freshness checked at load time.
